summary: Independent walk of all 61 checklist criteria found no High or Medium task-file failures at commit 069b0f2e. Harbor oracle reward 1.0 and NOP reward 0.0 are recorded for this freeze. Official GPT-5.5×5 plus Claude Opus 4.8×5 trials and trial-analysis flags are absent (Harbor LLMaJ deferred), so RC-META-004 and RC-TRIAL-001 through RC-TRIAL-006 remain INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Checklist-level recommendation is therefore INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not APPROVE.

evidence.observation: Two short paragraphs plus six bullets; absolute in-container paths; goal, CLI, journal, outputs, catalog overlay, and warehouse preservation are stated; task name and canary strings are absent.

Canonical Edition 3 fields are present and top-level: name matches folder, Software/Systems, five tags, python, difficulty=advanced, expert_time_estimate_hours=10, artifacts=[/app/sessions], separate verifier, agent timeout 7200, public network, standard resources.
Realistic binding contract for CLI, schemas, watermarks, lateness, gaps, restarts, catalog overlay, and JSONL outputs. Not a numbered repair walkthrough.
Digest-pinned canonical Python 3.13 slim base; tmux and asciinema installed in one apt transaction; copies sessions/ only; generates warehouse at build; no reserved-path or solution/tests copy.
Creates /logs/verifier at runtime, writes binary 0 then 1/0 after pytest, installs nothing, no trailing exit $?.

42 pytest functions with docstrings drive the submitted run-sessions CLI on isolated live state: usage-before-touch, empty/zero-event, gap/duration/lateness, tie-break vs feed, tenant isolation, restart, catalog overlay, warehouse preservation, holdout, and config mutation.
Copies five repaired modules then runs the public CLI on public fixtures; set -euo pipefail; no golden dump, no verifier reads, no reward writes.
Packet-recorded Harbor oracle reward 1.0 for this freeze. WSL /tmp was not readable here; recorded reward is accepted per packet.
Packet-recorded Harbor NOP reward 0.0 for this freeze.
Registry snapshot 2026-08-08-user-supplied lists 61 criteria. Live checklist URL returned 404, so policy freshness is UNVERIFIED.
Starter CLI touches journal before parse and clears journal on --reset-output, so NOP cannot satisfy usage-before-touch tests.

findings.why_it_matters: Difficulty is author-set to advanced. RC-META-004 requires alignment with mean pass@1 from official GPT-5.5×5 plus Claude Opus 4.8×5 trials. Those trials are not available on this freeze, so the High criterion cannot be passed or failed from evidence.
findings.minimal_remediation: Run the official ten Harbor trials, compute mean pass@1, set difficulty to the matching tier, then re-score RC-META-004. Do not treat this as a task-file defect until measured results exist.
findings.regression_risk: Changing difficulty without trials would be author intent again; wait for official runs.

findings.why_it_matters: RC-TRIAL-001 and RC-TRIAL-002 are High, and RC-TRIAL-003 through RC-TRIAL-006 are special Medium flags. No official trial-analysis artifacts were supplied (Harbor LLMaJ deferred). Absence of flags is not the same as examined-and-clear.
findings.minimal_remediation: Produce official trial-analysis dispositions for task_specification, reward_hacking, difficulty_crux, near_miss, refusals, and low_timeout, then re-score RC-TRIAL-001 through RC-TRIAL-006.
findings.regression_risk: Guessing PASS from missing flags would convert insufficient evidence into approval.
